headline: Riyadh tallest skyscraper hit for second time in a week leaving 11 injured
label: BREAKING
caption:
Riyadh was hit by a major security incident as its tallest skyscraper was struck again 🏙️

According to Dawn, Riyadh’s tallest skyscraper was struck for the second time in days on Tuesday, leaving 11 people injured. Saudi Arabia’s Civil Defence reported that the injured include citizens from Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Nepal and India.

The coalition fighting Houthis denounced the incident as a terrorist attack. Coalition spokesperson Turki alMalki stated that one of the towers in the financial centre was targeted in a cowardly terrorist attack.

Standing 385 metres high, the PIF tower serves as the headquarters of the Saudi Public Investment Fund and is a key landmark in the capital. The attack follows previous strikes on high profile targets since hostilities restarted in July.
